preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 20000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= n <= 200000 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[0] if c.isdigit())])
preconditions.description: This precondition is structurally complex; simplified: For each test case, n is between 3 and 200000.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 200000.
For each test case, the array a contains n integers where each a_i is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid integer.

For each test case i, the output value equals the maximum possible score achievable by optimally distributing the bricks into 3 non-empty bags, where the score is defined as min(|w1-w2| + |w2-w3|) over all choices of one brick wj from each bag j.
